name: ApiKey Recieved
purpose: Receives the API key and company id from the QBO authentication. Shows an error when the key is empty, asks to confirm when the company changed, then stores the company id and API key in QBOConfig and pulls the company information.
writes:
QBOConfig::CompanyID#17 (step 41, current record)
QBOConfig::ApiKey#18 (step 42, current record)
open_question: secret: stores the QBO apiKey in QBOConfig::ApiKey (step 42); the target must keep it in secret storage. Support contact text is in step 26.

name: On Connected Company Changed
purpose: Called when the connected QBO company changes. Warns and returns False if the file already holds data from the previous account; otherwise returns True.
open_question: Rule: switching QBO accounts is only allowed when all synced tables are empty.

name: On Get Config
purpose: Returns the QBO configuration by calling the QBO Config script.

name: Check for Data in Tables
purpose: Checks 13 synced tables (Bill, Class, Customer, Item, Estimate, Invoice, JournalEntry, Payment, PaymentMethod, PurchaseOrder, Term, Vendor, SalesReceipt) for any record and returns True when any table has data.
open_question: Uses Get(TotalRecordCount) per layout; the table list may not cover every synced entity (for example Deposit, Account, TaxCode).

name: On Revoke
purpose: On Revoke: goes to QBOConfig, sets the API key field, then deletes all CompanyInfo records.
writes:
QBOConfig::ApiKey#18 (step 7, current record)
delete: CompanyInfo (Delete All Records step 11, found set from step 10 Show All Records)
callers: none found (may be called by name: OAuth revoke hook)
open_question: secret: step 7 sets QBOConfig::ApiKey to $access_token, which is never set in this script (the API key is cleared or overwritten with an empty/unknown value). Delete All Records deletes the whole CompanyInfo table. No caller by id (called by the OAuth module by name).
